original.statement: The storage version of the clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD moves from v1beta1 to v1 (v1beta1 storage true → false); existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so a storage version migration is needed before a later release removes v1beta1.

decision.reason: [ev-a93bb3b1d26d] shows that between chart 0.15.0 and 0.16.0, spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage on clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io went from true to false, so v1 became the storage version. The upstream change text says existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, and that operators must run a storage version migration and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1. That operator step fits the migration family with migration-required, the only change type that family allows. The name is built from the evidence's own words, and including the kind keeps it apart from the same storage change on the other three CRDs [ev-d55f4ac0a53f, ev-10a72c580d6b, ev-f07fad593227].
